pdftext.summary: `loadShipped('pdftext')` is a small typesetter on pdfedit (headings, justified paragraphs, tables, flowcharts) - `help()` explains the calls, the page options (presets and `orientation`), the unit of a column width (a number is points, 'NN%' is a share of the text area) and what a run reports in `notes`/`dropped`/`diagrams`

diagram.summary: `loadShipped('diagram')` parses a Mermaid/DOT subset into a JSON model, lays it out itself (built-in base-14 widths, or a measure function of your own) and draws it as SVG or onto a PowerPoint slide (`pptx()`, editable shapes) - `help()` lists the subset, the `%%`-directives (pin/rank/port/weight/route/curve/layout), the two placement strategies (`layout: 'layered' | 'force'`), `fit()` (does a scene fit a page, at which scale, how small does the text get), `metric()` and the limits

diagram-model.summary: internal building block of `diagram`: the IR (nodes/edges/groups), its validation and the limits (loaded by `diagram.js` via `require`)

diagram-scene.summary: internal building block of `diagram`: the scene format (rect/ellipse/polygon/path/text/group), its bounds/normalize/orient helpers and the curve segments (rounded corners, Catmull-Rom spline) both backends draw

diagram-parse-dot.summary: internal building block of `diagram`: the DOT frontend (rankdir, subgraph, constraint, weight, ports) into the IR

diagram-parse-mermaid.summary: internal building block of `diagram`: the declared Mermaid flowchart subset frontend (shapes, edges, subgraph, `%%`-directives) into the IR

diagram-parse-state.summary: internal building block of `diagram`: the Mermaid state-diagram subset frontend (`[*]` pseudo states, transitions, composite states as groups) into the IR

diagram-fit.summary: internal building block of `diagram` and `pdftext`: the page presets, the orientation rule, the text area and the one scale formula behind `diagram.fit()`

diagram-metric.summary: internal building block of `diagram`: the advance widths of the base-14 fonts (exact for ASCII) behind `diagram.metric()`, which `layout()` uses when no measure function is injected

diagram-layout.summary: internal building block of `diagram`: the layout phases p0measure..p5route (cycles, ranks, order, place, orthogonal routing) producing a scene

diagram-force.summary: internal building block of `diagram`: the force-directed placement (spring embedder with rectangle repulsion, box separation, flow-direction term and a seeded multi-start) behind the `layout: 'force'` option

diagram-svg.summary: internal building block of `diagram`: the SVG backend that renders a scene to a self-contained SVG string

diagram-pdf.summary: internal building block of `diagram` and `pdftext`: the PDF backend that turns a scene into pdfedit ops (draw.rect/draw.line/text.put/content.append)

diagram-pptx.summary: internal building block of `diagram`: the PPTX backend - place()/ops() turn a scene into slide coordinates and drawing ops, draw()/write() perform them through the pptx bridge (a new file, a new slide or an existing slide)
